poseOrder:
Exactly FOUR complete actors in EACH of THREE rows,4+4+4=TWELVE. Strict fixed cell mapping:
TOP ROW: cell0=punch preparation; cell1=adapted close empty-hand punch contact; cell2=punch balanced recovery; cell3=heavy physical strike raised elbow/shoulder preparation.
MIDDLE ROW: cell4=heavy shoulder/forearm contact; cell5=heavy recovery; cell6=low sweep preparation, low crouch; cell7=low sweep contact, one fully extended leg.
BOTTOM ROW: cell8=low sweep recovery; cell9=ordinary backward hit recoil; cell10=KO controlled lowering onto one knee facing the requested direction; cell11=KO complete full-body side-lying rest, head toward the requested facing. Keep both legs/boots entirely visible, no blood or wounds.
The same long dark firearm remains attached compactly at the far back/side with a plain unobtrusive carry strap during the free-hand physical actions. Carry position is a versus adaptation, not proof of original sling hardware. No partner, floating gun or separate gear. No extra body: the low sweep triplet crosses a row boundary at6,7,8.
runtimeGroups: A idle2/walk4/guard2/crouch2/jump2; B punch3/heavy3/low3/hit1/ko2; C shoot3/deploy3/throw3/recover3
